unit: Herd × AID × SeasnYr × Season (all 4 fields required to define cluster); repeated fixes are dependent
approved_actions: read DBF record rows from the verified 12h ZIP ONLY to compute aggregate counts, field missingness, parseability, duplicates and within-cluster time intervals
check UTM_E/UTM_N numeric finite values and domain sanity without reporting any coordinates
retain per-animal group keys only in ephemeral memory; export aggregate counts, no raw fixes or individual IDs
calculate number of groups with at least 3 valid timestamped records and nominally 12h consecutive gaps
report up to 4 public herd names and aggregate season counts only; no GPS trace reconstruction
forbidden_actions: open GPS2hrs_Locs.zip or any withheld 2h observation
read SHP geometry records in this stage
export individual AID, exact timestamp, coordinates or path
fit/score EOG or comparator; tune temporal thresholds against the 2h file
reinterpret sparse-12h QC as independent biological validation

time_parsing.additional_iso8601: datetime.fromisoformat only if full string parsable; record aware vs naive and withhold UTC alignment
time_parsing.calendar_timezone: Publisher README indicates Mountain Time (MT); DBF field is text; do not assert UTC offsets or DST correction until independently defined

failure_policy: STOP if source hash changes, required field missing, data records malformed, time parse coverage <95%, or nonfinite coordinate fraction >5%; no reinterpretation of data post inspection
output_privacy: aggregate QC JSON only; no IDs, individual route, exact timestamps or coordinates
